about.title: About CineMind
about.mission.title: Discover Your Perfect Movie
about.mission.description: CineMind is the intelligent movie discovery platform that understands your unique taste. Using advanced AI and personalized CineDNA technology, we help you find movies that perfectly match your mood, preferences, and viewing history.
about.features.aiPowered.title: AI-Powered Recommendations
about.features.aiPowered.description: Our advanced AI understands your movie preferences to suggest perfect matches for your mood and taste.
about.features.cineDNA.title: CineDNA Technology
about.features.cineDNA.description: Personalized movie DNA that evolves with your viewing preferences, getting smarter with every interaction.
about.features.community.title: Community-Driven
about.features.community.description: Built for movie lovers, by movie lovers. Discover films you never knew existed.
about.features.precision.title: Precision Matching
about.features.precision.description: Find exactly what you're looking for with our intelligent search.
about.story.title: Our Story
about.story.paragraph1: CineMind was born from a simple frustration: spending more time searching for movies than actually watching them. We believed there had to be a better way to discover films that truly resonate with individual tastes.
about.story.paragraph2: Our team of movie enthusiasts and AI experts came together to create a platform that doesn't just recommend popular movies, but understands the nuances of what makes a film perfect for you at any given moment.
about.story.paragraph3: Today, CineMind helps thousands of users discover their next favorite movie, creating a more personalized and enjoyable movie-watching experience.
about.dataSources.title: About This App / Data Sources
about.dataSources.disclaimer: This product uses the OMDb API but is not endorsed or certified by OMDb.
about.dataSources.mediaNote: Movie posters and metadata are provided in accordance with OMDb API terms of use.

help.quickActions.title: Quick Actions
help.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
help.faq.howItWorks.question: How does CineMind work?
help.faq.howItWorks.answer: CineMind uses AI to understand your movie preferences and provide personalized recommendations. Simply describe what you're looking for, and our AI will suggest movies that match your mood and taste.
help.faq.cineDNA.question: What is CineDNA?
help.faq.cineDNA.answer: CineDNA is your personalized movie profile that learns from your searches and preferences. The more you use CineMind, the better it becomes at understanding your unique taste in movies.
help.faq.favorites.question: Can I save favorite movies?
help.faq.favorites.answer: Yes! You can add movies to your favorites list by clicking the heart icon. Access your favorites anytime from your profile.
help.faq.accuracy.question: How accurate are the recommendations?
help.faq.accuracy.answer: Our AI continuously learns from your interactions to improve recommendations. The more you use CineMind, the more accurate your suggestions become.
help.support.title: Still Need Help?
help.support.description: Can't find what you're looking for? Our support team is here to help.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: CineMind ("we," "our," or "us") values your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have when using our app.

privacy.section1.accountInfo.description: email address, display name, and any profile information you choose to provide.
